console.name: Nintendo - Nintendo Entertainment System
console.description: The Nintendo Entertainment System has a library of 1376[a] officially licensed games released during their lifespans, plus 7 official multicarts and 2 championship cartridges. Of these, 672 were released exclusively in Japan, 187 were released exclusively in North America, and 19 were released exclusively in PAL countries. Worldwide, 521 games were released.
